mapper.select: select count(cm.CTNT_NO) from contents_mst cm where 1=1

select cm.CTNT_NO, cm.CTNT_TITLE, cm.CTNT_SUBTITLE, cm.INP_USER, cm.DELETED_YN, tm.TAG_NO, tm.TAG_NAME, cm.INP_DTTM, cm.UPD_DTTM
from ( select CTNT_NO, CTNT_TITLE, CTNT_SUBTITLE, INP_USER, DELETED_YN, INP_DTTM, UPD_DTTM from contents_mst order by CTNT_NO desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset} ) cm left join contents_tags ct on cm.CTNT_NO = ct.CTNT_NO left join tags_mst tm on ct.TAG_NO = tm.TAG_NO order by cm.CTNT_NO desc, tm.TAG_NO

select cm.CTNT_NO, cm.CTNT_TITLE, cm.CTNT_SUBTITLE, cd.CTNT_BODY, cm.INP_USER, cm.DELETED_YN, tm.TAG_NO, tm.TAG_NAME, cm.INP_DTTM, cm.UPD_DTTM from contents_mst cm inner join contents_dtl cd on cm.CTNT_NO = cd.CTNT_NO left join contents_tags ct on cm.CTNT_NO = ct.CTNT_NO left join tags_mst tm on ct.TAG_NO = tm.TAG_NO where cm.CTNT_NO = #{ctntNp} order by cm.CTNT_NO desc, tm.TAG_NO

select count(DISTINCT cm.CTNT_NO) from contents_mst cm
inner join contents_dtl cd on cm.CTNT_NO = cd.CTNT_NO
left join contents_tags ct on cm.CTNT_NO = ct.CTNT_NO left join tags_mst tm on ct.TAG_NO = tm.TAG_NO where 1=1
and cm.CTNT_TITLE like concat('%', #{param}, '%')
and cd.CTNT_BODY like concat('%', #{param}, '%')
and (cm.CTNT_TITLE like concat('%', #{param}, '%') or cd.CTNT_BODY like concat('%', #{param}, '%'))
and tm.TAG_NAME like concat('%', #{param}, '%')

select cm.CTNT_NO, cm.CTNT_TITLE, cm.CTNT_SUBTITLE, cm.INP_USER, cm.DELETED_YN, tm.TAG_NO, tm.TAG_NAME, cm.INP_DTTM, cm.UPD_DTTM
from ( select cm.CTNT_NO, cm.CTNT_TITLE, cm.CTNT_SUBTITLE, cm.INP_USER, cm.DELETED_YN, cm.INP_DTTM, cm.UPD_DTTM from contents_mst cm
inner join contents_dtl cd on cm.CTNT_NO = cd.CTNT_NO
where 1=1
and cm.CTNT_TITLE like concat('%', #{param}, '%')
and cd.CTNT_BODY like concat('%', #{param}, '%')
and (cm.CTNT_TITLE like concat('%', #{param}, '%') or cd.CTNT_BODY like concat('%', #{param}, '%'))
and exists (select 1 from contents_tags sct inner join tags_mst stm on sct.TAG_NO = stm.TAG_NO where sct.CTNT_NO = cm.CTNT_NO and stm.TAG_NAME like concat('%', #{param}, '%'))
order by cm.CTNT_NO desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset} ) cm left join contents_tags ct on cm.CTNT_NO = ct.CTNT_NO left join tags_mst tm on ct.TAG_NO = tm.TAG_NO order by cm.CTNT_NO desc, tm.TAG_NO
